title: New banned/restricted card notice from Bandai (posted 17 Nov)
detail: The official site lists a 'Banned/Restricted Card Addition Notice' dated 17 Nov, but the card list is not readable in the news index. A fan site (onepiece.gg) says it takes effect 27 Nov, tomorrow. Unconfirmed: check the official notice before buying or selling any One Piece staples.
source: Bandai One Piece Card Game (official news)

title: Aura Seeker (ME7) goes on sale in Japan tomorrow, 27 Nov
detail: Headliner is Mega Lucario Z ex, the first Mega Z card. English version (Flowing Fists) is reported for 5 or 6 Feb 2027; sources disagree and The Pokémon Company has not confirmed. Expect Japanese pull and price news over the weekend.

title: This weekend: Regionals in Stuttgart and Alicante, Sat 28 Nov
detail: Both are on the calendar for Saturday. Results usually appear on Limitless that evening in Europe, which is the night in Mauritius.

title: Still no results for the One Piece regionals of 7, 14 and 21 Nov
detail: Limitless has no new Pokémon results since Chiba (22 Nov) and nothing for the One Piece regionals, so those stay unconfirmed. No big price moves checked today: Mew ex 152 is unchanged from yesterday (7-day €74.19 vs 30-day €81.47).
